def _get_done_status(self, generated, batch):
    done_idx = torch.minimum(
        (generated != self.EOS_TOKEN_ID).sum(dim=-1) - batch.prompt_rindex,
        torch.tensor(self.max_new_tokens) - 1,
    )
    done = torch.zeros(
        done_idx.numel(),
        self.max_new_tokens,
        dtype=torch.bool,
        device=generated.device,
    )
    terminal = (generated[:, -1] == self.EOS_TOKEN_ID)
    truncated = (done_idx >= self.max_new_tokens - 1)
    return done.scatter(-1, done_idx.unsqueeze(-1), 1).unsqueeze(-1), terminal, truncated
